full_text: AFTER VISIT SUMMARY Nicolas Hernandez MRN: [redacted]38 10/16/2025 @ UCLA Ronald Reagan Emergency Department 310-267-8400. Thank you for choosing UCLA Health for your care. Instructions. UCLA Health. Emergency Department Discharge Instructions. Summary of your visit: You have been evaluated in the UCLA Emergency Department today scooter accident. You were evaluated by the Emergency Medicine team and Trauma team. Your evaluation included a physical exam and CT scans of your brain, neck, which did not show evidence of acute injuries. Our facial surgeons and orthopedic hand surgeons repaired your lacerations. Her x-ray was concerning for a fracture over your left hand for which we consulted our orthopedic hand surgery colleagues. We have observed you in the ER and have determined that you are stable for discharge at this time. Follow-Up: Please follow up with your primary care physician within three days after being discharged from the ER to check on your symptoms. You will also need a referral to a hand specialist to have an appointment within the next week for further management of your fracture and laceration of your hand. Return to the Emergency Department if you experience: Fevers 100.4 °F or greater, Worsening or uncontrolled pain, Persistent nausea and vomiting, Chest pain or shortness of breath, Numbness or weakness in your arms, legs, or groin, Fainting or confusion, Any other concerning symptoms. Thank you for choosing UCLA for your care. It was a pleasure taking part in your care today, and we wish you the best! Your medications have changed today. See your updated medication list for details. Pick up these medications at UCLA RONALD REAGAN OUTPATIENT PHARM (310-206-3784): cephalexin. Address: 757 Westwood Plaza Suite B140, Los Angeles CA 90095. Hours: Mon-Fri 8AM-9PM, Sat 8AM-7PM, Sun, & Holidays 8AM-5PM. Phone: 310-267-8524.
